name: Limits & pause screen
desc: Copy needs clinical/legal review. Levels map to PlatformModuleConfig.tier (Notice 1, Pause 2, Pause + step 3, Firm 5 = no overrides). Small step maps to gate breath | commitment | puzzle. Device-only: nothing here is sent to Tether. Looser limits take effect the next day.

children.text: On iPhone, opens are counted from pause screens shown, so the number is approximate.

items.label: Pause screen
items.sub: A pause before the app opens

items.label: Pause and one small step
items.sub: A breath, a typed sentence or a quick sum first

body.text: Stricter limits apply now. Looser limits start tomorrow, so one hard moment doesn’t change your plan.
Every pause screen has a Get support button. Tether, the phone dialer and emergency calling can never be chosen or paused.

notes: Source: pigeons/unplug_api.dart @ origin/feat/unplug-v2.1-module PlatformThresholds(minutes, opens), PlatformModuleConfig(tier, overrideAllowance, gate none|breath|commitment|puzzle, strict); lib/unplug/screens/unplug_screen_f.dart (tier, cool-off)

Native requirement (iOS shield and app selection, Android overlay, picker and service): never shield or pause Tether, the phone dialer or emergency calling, even if they are selected or a session pauses "everything". Needs device validation.

actions.summary: CALL device:unplug/setThresholds+applyShield then toast “Unplug is on” then replace → sf_unplug_home
